evidence.title: The Illusion of Control: Why Bare Classifier Inversion Silently Fails in Concept-Bottleneck Text Generation

summary: Researchers expose the limitations of bare classifier inversion in concept-bottleneck text generation, highlighting its silent failures and the illusion of control. The findings underscore the need for more robust methods in AI-driven text generation.
title: Study Reveals Flaws in Concept-Bottleneck Text Generation with Bare Classifier Inversion
